titulo_es.@es: «Would» para acciones repetidas en relatos del pasado
titulo_es.@en: «Would» for repeated actions in past stories

would.es: solía; solían (acción repetida en un relato pasado)

texto.@es: **When I was at school, our class visited a museum every spring. The guide would show us old exhibits.** En este uso, **would + verbo base** presenta una acción típica y repetida dentro del periodo pasado; es frecuente en relatos y algo más formal que **used to**. El pasado simple también puede expresar rutinas, como **our class visited ... every spring**. En **would show ... and answer**, un solo **would** rige ambos verbos.
texto.@en: * * When I was at school, our class visited a museum every spring. The guide would show us old exhibits.** En este uso, **would + verb base** presenta una acción típica y repetida dentro del periodo pasado; es frecuente en relatos y algo más formal que **used to * *. The simple past can also express routines, such as **our class visited ... every spring**. In **would show ... and answer**, a single **would** governs both verbs.

texto.@es: No se suele usar el **would** habitual en preguntas o negativas y no sirve para describir estados pasados: **We used to live nearby**, no *we would live nearby* con ese sentido. Para un suceso que ocurrió una sola vez, usa el pasado simple.
texto.@en: The usual **would** is not usually used in questions or negatives and is not used to describe past states: **We used to live nearby**, no * we would live near * with that sense. For an event that happened once, use the simple past.

frases.en: When I was at school, our class visited a small museum every spring.
frases.es: Cuando estudiaba, nuestra clase visitaba un museo pequeño cada primavera.

frases.en: The guide would show us old machines and answer our questions.
frases.es: Nos enseñaba máquinas antiguas y respondía a nuestras preguntas.

frases.en: We would draw our favourite exhibit in a notebook.
frases.es: Dibujábamos nuestra pieza favorita del museo en un cuaderno.

frases.en: One spring, the museum was closed, so we visited a nearby castle instead.
frases.es: Una primavera, el museo estaba cerrado, así que visitamos un castillo cercano en su lugar.

analisis.@es: una ocasión concreta; por eso se usa el pasado simple
analisis.@en: a concrete occasion; that is why the simple past is used

pregunta.@es: In this story, what does “The guide would show us old machines” mean?
pregunta.@en: In this story, what does The guide would show us old machines?

opciones.texto: On repeat visits, showing the machines was a typical action for the guide.
opciones.explicacion: Past **would + base verb** presents a repeated action in a past narrative.

opciones.texto: The guide will show them in the future.
opciones.explicacion: The story is set in the narrator's school years.

opciones.texto: The guide refused to show them.

explicacion.@es: The sentence does not describe a refusal.
explicacion.@en: The sentence does not describe a rebuttal.

bloques.frase: The guide would ___ us old machines and answer our questions.

opciones.texto: show
opciones.explicacion: After **would**, use the base form.

opciones.texto: showed
opciones.explicacion: A past-tense form does not follow the modal **would**.

opciones.texto: showing
opciones.explicacion: An **-ing** form does not follow **would** in this structure.

opciones.explicacion: The text does not mention another school.

Close the museum and take the class to a castle.

opciones.explicacion: The final sentence gives the reason.

opciones.explicacion: This was one specific event, so the past simple is used.

bloques.frase: The guide would show us old machines and answer our questions.

opciones.texto: Nos enseñaba máquinas antiguas y respondía a nuestras preguntas.
opciones.explicacion: **Would + base verb** presents these as typical repeated actions in the past.

opciones.explicacion: That would be a future meaning.

pregunta.@es: Which sentence describes a past state rather than a repeated action?
pregunta.@en: When sentence describes a past state rather than a repeated action?

opciones.texto: We used to live near the museum.

explicacion.@es: **Live** describes a state; use **used to** or the past simple for it, not habitual **would**.
explicacion.@en: **Live** describes a state; use **used to** or the past simple for it, not usual **would**.

opciones.texto: The guide would show us old machines each spring.
opciones.explicacion: This is a repeated action.

opciones.texto: We would draw an exhibit in our notebooks.
opciones.explicacion: This is a repeated action.

bloques.pregunta: What is an “exhibit” in this museum story?

opciones.texto: An object displayed for people to see.
opciones.explicacion: A museum exhibit is an object or collection shown to visitors.

opciones.texto: A person who answers questions.
opciones.explicacion: That is the guide.

opciones.texto: A notebook used by the class.
opciones.explicacion: The class uses a notebook to draw in it.

intro.@es: En un relato, una vez establecido el periodo pasado, **would + verbo base** puede presentar acciones que se repetían. No confundas este uso con otros significados de **would**.
intro.@en: In a story, once the last period has been established, **would + verbo base** may present repeated actions. Do not confuse this use with other meanings of **would**.
